title: Feasibility audit for 0050 constituent-change fragility event study

verdict.plain_english: The repo contains 0050 price history but not a canonical historical constituent-change event table. Without official add/delete events, any event study would be fabricated or hand-assembled from unstable secondary sources.

minimum_required_canonical_input.why_needed: Event-study / DiD design requires exact announcement dates, effective dates, and add/delete membership events before any volatility inference can be trusted.

recommended_next_step.phase_1: Build canonical historical event table from official FTSE/TWSE/Yuanta sources
recommended_next_step.phase_2: Run add/delete event-study on abs_ret, park_var, and idiosyncratic volatility
